text:
Ok gear split time 🏕️ everyone check what you have
tent: Ruo-han? (you have the 4p right)
stove + gas: Jun-jie
cooler + ice: Ci-yun?
Chairs x4 + table: me
lanterns / headlamps: whoever
food list is separate, not doing that tonight 😅
Stove yes, 2 gas canisters
Cooler yes but only the small one ice is a problem tho
Small is fine we're 4 🙏 ice we buy on the way
Tent yes. 4p, the one from last year. Poles might be bent at one corner, check before we go
Oh good call. Can you check it this weekend?
Yeah sat morning
Headlamps I have 2
So we need 1 more light
I can bring the battery lantern from my dorm, it's kinda dim tho
👍🏻 ok
[link: campsite listing, Wulai riverside site]
Is this one still ok for the 20th? Reviews are mixed on the bathroom
The bathroom is always bad at those water is the real question, check if there's a tap
Tap yes I think, reviews mention it
Can't sleep lol who else is still up
Me same
Lol so nobody's sleeping
Morning. Reread the listing, reviews say the tap is by the toilet block
[photo: campsite tap and hose]
Ok good 👏 ill bring the big water jug anyway
My lantern battery might be dead, will check later 🔋
Booking not confirmed yet, host replies slow. Will check tonight
Lunch rush then a customer wanting three different cough syrups for "the whole family"
Back from the shop. Car needs an oil change before sunday, that's my afternoon gone
Booked. 19th-20th, check in 2pm, out by noon
Nice
Ok adding to my list. Ice is 1 bag or 2?
2. Cooler is small
2 bags. Lantern is fine if it charges
Going to sleep for real now
Me too. The lanterns are on my list
Anyone bringing a tarp? Listing says almost no tree shade
Checking tent now
Tarp yes, the big blue one from my mom's place 🏕️ ill bring it
Ok good
[photo: tent poles laid out on the garage floor]
One pole is bent about 3cm at the joint. Can straighten it but not sure it'll hold under wind
Oh no can you get a replacement?
Maybe. The brand is old, will check the shop in Shilin. Or I can try the spare sleeve from my other tent if the diameter matches
Which one is more likely to work?
No idea till I measure. After lunch
Lantern battery is dead lol. Charging it now, will see if it comes back
[screenshot: host message]
Gate code comes on the 18th. They want us to reply "ok" to the message to confirm our arrival time
Lunch break two people asked for the same cough syrup within an hour. Flu season came early this year
Measured. Spare sleeve is 1mm too thin. Will bodge it or buy the right part
Can you just use tape
Lol no
Lantern works!! 40% charge. Still kinda dim but yeah
Still at the office, will be late
Off shift finally. So tired
Shop had the right pole section. 8 euro lol, need 2 pieces. Will pick up Monday
👏👏 good
Who's bringing pots
Not me, I have a tiny kettle from my dorm
I have a pan 🍳
Lol so we're cooking gourmet
Pan + kettle is fine
Headlamps need AAA batteries, anyone have spares
I have some
Forecast app says rain on the 19th?? Maybe
Too early, forecast is 7 days out. Will check again closer to the date
Going to bed for real this time
